'''Nebit's tribe''' was a clan of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] led by [[Nebit/Legends|Nebit]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Other members included [[Jek Nkik]], [[Uutkik]], [[Pachwenko]], [[Ukchet]], [[Ezjenk]], [[Zubwen]], brothers [[Enjikket]] and [[Yeelhoy]], and their uncle [[Dathcha/Legends|Dathcha]].

They were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] when [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] searched for [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].
